title: True indicator characterization
statement: For a DNF term $T$ on $n$ coordinates and an input $x\in\{\pm1\}^n$, its true indicator equals $1$ if and only if the term evaluates to $-1$ at $x$.
hypotheses_covered: A DNF term on n coordinates
